title: fix(app-shell): name the copy buttons in an action's result dialog and announce the copied state
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoCFC5prTTPschL4i6Cz14L9)_

Fixes #28186

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作结果弹窗（邀请链接、新 API 密钥、2FA 密钥等只显示一次的值）里每个仅图标的「复制」按钮现在都有可读的名称，例如「复制 Email」；没有字段标签时叫「复制值」，备用码列表按序号叫「复制 备用码 第 2 项」。复制成功后，读屏会念出「已复制到剪贴板」。
- 为什么改：读屏或语音控制用户以前只听到「按钮」，分不清它是复制哪个值，也没法按名字点它；值只显示一次，漏复制就得把动作重做一遍。
- 风险与回滚：只改渲染层，弹窗的布局与复制行为不变（新的播报区是视觉隐藏的）；十个语言包各加 5 个键。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx`（`CopyButton` 与 `ResultField` 里的 `copyName`）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ActionResultDialog.test.tsx` 新增的 describe；`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` 的 `actions.resultDialog`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ActionResultDialog.test.tsx`，预期 1 个文件、12 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Names** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx`). `ResultField` already resolves the field's `I18nLabel`; it now builds the accessible name of that field's copy buttons from it and hands it to the format block (`QrcodeBlock`, `SecretBlock`, `TextBlock`, `JsonBlock`, `CodeListBlock`):

- a labelled field: `actions.resultDialog.copyField` ("Copy LABEL");
- an unlabelled field, including the whole-payload JSON fallback: `actions.resultDialog.copyValue` ("Copy value");
- each code of a code list, by 1-based position: `copyFieldItem` ("Copy LABEL, item N") or `copyItem` ("Copy item N").

`CopyButton` takes either a visible `label` (that text is its name, as "Copy all" already was) or a `name` that becomes its `aria-label`; the prop type makes one of the two required, so a new icon-only use cannot compile without a name. The `Copy` / `Check` icons are marked `aria-hidden`.

**Copied state.** Each `CopyButton` renders a visually hidden `role="status"` region (implicitly polite) beside the button. It is mounted empty and filled with `actions.resultDialog.copied` ("Copied to clipboard") while the copied state lasts, so a screen reader announces the change. It is positioned out of flow by `sr-only`, so the flex rows keep their layout.

**Translations.** The five keys are added under `actions.resultDialog` in all ten packs (`en`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt`, `ru`, `ar`), next to the existing `copyAll`.

**#27521's focus pins.** The change does not touch `useActionDialogReturnFocus` or the dialog's focus props; `actionDialogFocus-27521.test.tsx` is run below as a control.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ActionResultDialog.test.tsx` gains a describe, "every copy button has an accessible name", with role-and-name queries. The file's `useObjectTranslation` stub now echoes interpolation params after the key, so a name shows which label reached it (existing assertions use no params and are unchanged).

- each of a text, secret, qrcode and json field's copy button is found by `getByRole('button', { name: 'actions.resultDialog.copyField(label=LABEL)' })`;
- the whole-payload fallback's button is named `copyValue`;
- a labelled code list's per-code buttons are named `copyFieldItem` with index 1 and 2, and "Copy all" keeps its visible name; an unlabelled list's are named `copyItem`;
- no button in the dialog is left without a name (all buttons equal the buttons with a non-blank name);
- the `status` region exists and is empty before the click, `writeText` receives the value, and the same region node then reads `actions.resultDialog.copied`.

## Acceptance notes

- "Copy all" keeps its visible text as its accessible name. Two code-list fields in one dialog would show two "Copy all" buttons with the same name; no shipped `resultDialog` declares two code lists, so this is noted, not changed.
- The live region announces only a successful copy. A refused clipboard write still does nothing visible or audible, as before; the value stays on screen for a manual copy.
